basis: Fitted: fixed per-request energy 68.7 J from the ET-01/ET-02 two-point fit, divided by the 4096-token context of that configuration
caveat: Includes generation-setup cost, so it is an upper bound on pure prefill; Llama-3.2-1B on H200, batch 16, 4K context

basis: Fitted: marginal slope of the ET-01/ET-02 two-point fit (10 and 512 output tokens at a matched request configuration)
caveat: Same configuration as above; per-token energy is not transferable across context length or batch size

basis: 41-45% of system energy is invisible to GPU-only telemetry; 0.41/0.59 = 0.69 at the low end
caveat: Measured on a 2-GPU workstation-class node; the authors present it as a lower bound on boundary error, not a universal constant

basis: ASSUMPTION: 25% of the 400-600 W per-GPU power-cap band over which throughput is unaffected
caveat: No retrieved source reports idle or static accelerator power under an agent loop. This is the model's only unanchored parameter and it is swept over 50-300 W

basis: Operator-reported fleet-average PUE, low end of the 1.08-1.29 range across six operators
caveat: Self-reported and unaudited; reporting periods differ across operators

basis: Model-scale energy multiplier relative to the reference serving configuration; 1.0 means the measured 1B-class reference
caveat: Upper bound 8.6x taken from a 7B-vs-sub-1.5B comparison on consumer hardware; no retrieved source gives per-token energy for a datacentre-served model above 7B

basis: Prefix-cache hit rate at each operating point (OP-A retains serving state, OP-B evicts it). Set by the residency constraint, not fitted.
caveat: No retrieved source gives compute saved as a function of cache hit rate; the model computes avoided prefill tokens directly rather than applying an empirical curve

basis: ASSUMPTION: order of a few CPU-seconds of retrieval or code execution
caveat: No retrieved source reports per-call tool or environment energy for agent workloads

basis: ASSUMPTION: time stalled on a tool call with serving capacity reserved
caveat: Tool-induced idle time is identified as a cost source by luo2026where but no duration is reported

basis: Best reported agent end-to-end success on a realistic web environment (human 78.24%)
